1.w: So these three men refused to answer Job further, because he was righteous in his own eyes.

2.w: Then Elihu son of Barakel the Buzite, of the family of Ram, became very angry. He was angry with Job for justifying himself rather than God.

3.w: With Job’s three friends he was also angry because they could not find an answer, and so declared Job guilty.

4.w: Now Elihu had waited before speaking to Job because the others were older than he was.

5.w: But when Elihu saw that the three men had no further reply, he became very angry.

6.w: So Elihu son of Barakel the Buzite spoke up: “I am young, but you are elderly; that is why I was fearful and afraid to explain to you what I know.

7.w: I said to myself, ‘Age should speak, and length of years should make wisdom known.’

8.w: But it is a spirit in people, the breath of the Almighty, that makes them understand.

9.w: It is not the aged who are wise, nor old men who understand what is right.

10.w: Therefore I say, ‘Listen to me. I, even I, will explain what I know.’

11.w: Look, I waited for you to speak; I listened closely to your wise thoughts, while you were searching for words.

12.w: Now I was paying you close attention, yet there was no one proving Job wrong, not one of you was answering his statements.

13.w: So do not say, ‘We have found wisdom. God will refute him, not man.’

14.w: Job has not directed his words to me, and so I will not reply to him with your arguments.

15.w: “They are dismayed and cannot answer anymore; they have nothing left to say.

16.w: And I have waited. But because they do not speak, because they stand there and answer no more,

17.w: I too will answer my part; I too will explain what I know.

18.w: For I am full of words, and the spirit within me constrains me.

19.w: Inside I am like wine that has no outlet, like new wineskins ready to burst!

20.w: I will speak, so that I may find relief; I will open my lips, so that I may answer.

21.w: I will not show partiality to any person, nor will I confer a title on anyone.

22.w: For I do not know how to give honorary titles; if I did, my Creator would quickly do away with me.
